predecessors.name: Lelang Commandery
predecessors.text: Lelang, 'seized' by Wang Tiao; the page gives no extent of his hold, so the core of the commandery is assumed

successors.name: Lelang Commandery
successors.text: Lelang, 'seized' by Wang Tiao; the page gives no extent of his hold, so the core of the commandery is assumed

ledger.x: 30: Wang Tiao's regime ends with the arrival of the governor Wang Zun.

wars.name: Wang Tiao's rebellion in Lelang
wars.outcome: The rebellion holds Lelang for five years and is put down by Wang Zun, appointed governor by Emperor Guangwu.

certainty.note: No extent is given on the page.
